title: Global overview attention rows advertise open but Enter is a no-op
description: Evidence: all routes receive drill binding/footer hints, global.overview reports active list length from attention, and the table renders with a cursor; handleDrill has cases for repo routes, global.projects, and global.queues, but not global.overview. Impact: the main global alert list is keyboard-selectable but not actionable.
acceptanceCriteria: Enter on a global overview attention row opens the relevant project/health context, or the route removes cursor/drill affordances.
A route-shell test covers the chosen behavior.
